claim: Reviewed classic/TENT facade selection: MC_USE_TENT or MC_USE_TEV1 selects the TENT-capable branch; TENT installTransport is a compatibility no-op.
Reviewed pointer-backed classic BatchID allocation and deferred cleanup ownership; freeBatchID transfers busy batches to the cleanup worker and invalidates the public ID.
Corrected guide coverage: both OK and BatchCleanupDeferred invalidate the batch handle while deferred cleanup may still have transport-owned buffers.
Reviewed tryFreeBatchID: terminal task status is insufficient for deletion until active completion callbacks are quiescent.
RealSliceTimeoutDefersBatchCleanup asserts TIMEOUT then deferred cleanup, invalidated ID wording, and eventual internal release after the slice fails.
FinishedBatchWaitsForCompletionCallbackQuiescence asserts a terminal batch is retained while its completion callback remains active.
Reviewed scatter operation move-only ownership, physical-completion destructor, single-consumer waits, and timeout that does not cancel work.
Reviewed classic forced TCP compile guard, SHM single/multi-protocol distinction, and EFA versus RC RDMA discovery branch.
Reviewed preferred versus available HCA lists and the distinction between exact device lookup and fallback selection.
Reviewed Create order: master connection and storage preparation precede rpc_only early return, and normal clients initialize/reuse Transfer Engine afterward.
Reviewed mount order: validation and overlap checks precede registration, then master mount, then local UUID bookkeeping; the shown mount-RPC failure does not undo registration.
Reviewed unmount order: withdraw capacity through master before unregistering local memory and erasing the mounted entry.
Reviewed general best-effort placement: preferred/excluded entries are deduplicated, candidate allocation can fail, and a nonempty short result can be returned.
FailedPreferencesFallBackBestEffort requests three and returns two, with zero allocation calls to the excluded candidate.
Reviewed preferred-only named/kind allocation as a separate contract that does not silently use a different candidate kind.
Reviewed immutable Put: OBJECT_ALREADY_EXISTS becomes success after the defined dangling local-disk healing retry; this is not overwrite success.
Reviewed flexible write-mode gate: exactly one memory and one NoF replica with no DFS selects FLEXIBLE_DUAL_REPLICA.
Reviewed HasExpectedReplicaAllocation: ordinary memory-only writes accept a nonempty allocation, while other reliable media configurations use exact counts.
Reviewed finalization summary: successful memory with failed NoF can End MEMORY and revoke NOF_SSD while reporting overall success, subject to metadata RPC outcomes.
Reviewed PutEnd and PutRevoke authority: both compare calling UUID with the initiating metadata client UUID.
Reviewed PutEnd idempotence: no-primary-write retries succeed only when targeted replicas exist and are already complete; eligible targeted PROCESSING replicas advance.
PutEndMemoryDoesNotCompleteNoFReplica asserts one complete readable memory copy and preservation after type-specific NoF revoke; ALL case checks both media.
Reviewed read lookup: absent/all-removed state differs from replicas-not-ready; normal lookup grants a lease and defers follow-up work until its read accessor is released.
Reviewed Query deadline: steady-clock time is captured before metadata RPC and returned TTL is added to that start.
Reviewed descriptor Get ordering: select for destination, transfer, release used hot-cache reference, handle transfer error, verify logical checksum, then reject expiry.
ClientVerifiesOnlyLogicalObjectBytes checks a 16-byte object in 20-byte capacity: trailing-byte mutation passes and logical-byte mutation fails checksum.
BatchGetChecksLeasesWithPreferredNode proves expired results can contain correctly copied bytes; BatchGetPreservesTransferErrorWithExpiredLease preserves transfer-error precedence.
Reviewed move-only BufferHandle allocator-owned mode and callback-backed view mode; slices do not themselves own the referenced allocation.
Reviewed Acquire pageable fallback versus AllocatePinned no-fallback behavior and bounded cached buffer count.
Reviewed CAS monotonic maximum lease grants and explicit exact SetDeadline test operation; client and server clocks are not interchangeable absolute timestamps.
Reviewed grouped objects sharing one Lease pointer, so one member read can extend group protection without changing lookup identity.
Reviewed ACTIVE serving, SUSPECTED retaining, OFFLINE terminal state, and transition-mutex-backed serving/retaining guards.
Reviewed actual-transition suspicion start and ObserveAndRun committing observation only when wrapped operation succeeds.
Reviewed reservation-before-OFFLINE and retirement-outside-transition-lock assertions, including a concurrent guard probe.
Reviewed authoritative hard-pin/active-lease checks before policy and stale candidate revalidation before reclaim.
Reviewed offload source pinning, task ownership, reduced immediate-release plan, completed disk preservation, and forced-drop alternatives.
PinsOneReplicaAndReleasesTheRest asserts queued bytes and actual released bytes separately; rejected-offload tests distinguish preservation from forced eviction.
Reviewed effective operation logging gate requiring enable_ha, enable_oplog, and backend support.
Reviewed ordinary PutEnd: readability/accounting publication precedes AppendOpLogVisibleBeforeDurable and queue failure is logged rather than universally returned as failed durable commit.
Reviewed indivisible grouped commits, admission reservations, and AwaitDurable futures independent of callback completion and fulfilled outside writer mutex.
Reviewed object size/CRC or readback verification, manifest/descriptor upload, and candidate-prefix cleanup on failure.
Reviewed publication requiring maintenance ownership token, held lease, transaction support, and cluster identity separately from artifact writing.
Reviewed isolated rebootstrap candidate, replay to durable prefix, compaction-floor recheck, stop-aware lock acquisition, and old-state-preserving swap.
Reviewed restore assertions for same-endpoint address identity, skipping size-invalid objects, and failing closed on ambiguous overlapping restored ranges.
Reviewed corrupt-latest fallback/suffix replay and corrupt-candidate old-state preservation until repaired.
Reviewed omission of read leases and runtime soft pins from standby object metadata while hard-pin state is serialized separately.
Reviewed model/rank/group/optional format/deployment prefixes before chunk hash and layout-specific physical shard mapping.
Reviewed padding assertion: one logical block copies 40 bytes while a two-page contiguous span copies 64+40 bytes.
Reviewed producer-event synchronization before Store puts, strict result/key/block pairing on reads, failed block reporting, and drained-transfer registration renewal.
Reviewed device unregister/restore idempotence, preserved host registrations, and failed-region retry convergence assertions.
Reviewed raw tensor metadata copied through accelerator abstraction, bounds/overflow validation, and preservation of original caller addresses for staging/IPC.
